spellbook.finance/limitations: Facts only. No store ranking, split calculation, purchase recommendation, checkout or purchase is performed.
Offers preserve native currency and exact product identity. Shipping, tax, stock and destination eligibility can remain unknown; item subtotal is not landed cost.
List reads contain at most 100 lines; offer reads contain at most 10 lines and 80 offers per product. Follow nextCursor; completeList describes saved-list traversal, never complete merchant coverage.

description: Create a local sealed retailer price target and return its saved status and observed match facts. Call with an exact product and explicit native-currency threshold. Read spellbook_sealed_price_target next; a target records observations without reserving or purchasing products.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

currency.description: Native offer currency; no conversion or delivered total is inferred.

destinationCountry.description: Destination ISO country code; shipping eligibility can remain unknown.

productId.description: Exact catalog productId from sealed product discovery; variants and package sizes are distinct.

retailerMarketRegion.description: Retailer market to observe; this does not establish delivery eligibility.

targetAmount.description: Maximum native amount for one exact product unit before shipping and tax.

name: spellbook_sealed_price_target_create
